description: This file defines a command handler class 'CreateFundCommandHandler' used for processing 'CREATE' actions on 'FUND' entities within the Fineract project. It handles incoming commands to create new funds and delegates the processing to the 'FundWritePlatformService'.

classes.name: CreateFundCommandHandler
classes.description: A Spring service class that handles 'CREATE' commands for 'FUND' entities. It processes incoming fund creation commands and invokes the fund write service.

methods.name: processCommand
methods.description: Processes the incoming JsonCommand to create a new fund by delegating to the write platform service. Annotated as transactional.
